test_shared_memberships_have_stable_ids_and_deterministic_replay (code_variable_map and mapping_count): one row per (variable, code and label) a variable carries. One stored value set per distinct membership. A changed label, an added member and ab/c beside a/bc each stay a set of their own (old test: five distinct ids). TWIN's two version labels share one set.
